note: Adapted from Maiti 2006; original in English; the text of this entry begins with the wing venation description, and the paragraphs on the colouration and chaetotaxy of the head and thorax of the alate are not present in this scan, so the alate section contains only the wing venation and measurements. In Table 17 the pronotum length and width rows have only two sets of values in the extracted text, and the first set is taken for this species by column order.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head long oval, distinctly longer than wide, narrowed anteriorly, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle opening just behind the posterior margin of the postclypeus; eyes and ocelli absent; antennae 13—15-segmented, segment 2 about half of segment 1; labrum slightly longer than wide, the tip pointed with a transparent end, with a pair of long setae below the tip; mandibles sabre-shaped, the tips incurved; postmentum long, rod-like, widest in the anterior third; pronotum flat, narrower than the head width, anterior margin convex with a distinct blunt median notch.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Wings: the media and cubitus of the forewing distinct in the proximal third, weak and fine in the distal two thirds, each marked by a row of hairs; forewing scale longer than the hindwing scale; costa and subcosta fused; media arising independently from the wing scale margin, with 1—3 weak branches distally; cubitus parallel to the media, with 8—13 branches reaching the posterior margin; cubitus of the hindwing with 9—12 branches. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 14.00—16.00; body length without wings 6.00—7.40; head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.00—1.08; head width including the eyes 1.30—1.53; head height 0.55—0.57; postclypeus length 0.08—0.09, width 0.55—0.58; labrum length 0.33—0.40, width 0.43; maximum eye diameter 0.38—0.43; maximum ocellus diameter 0.14—0.15; eye—ocellus distance 0.012—0.038; eye—antenna distance 0.03—0.05; pronotum length 0.68—0.85, width 1.10—1.14; forewing length 8.50—10.70, forewing scale 0.90—1.15; hindwing length 8.00—10.20, hindwing scale 0.55—0.68; antennae 19—23-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, paler in the fontanelle region; head and pronotum sparsely hairy, abdomen moderately hairy. Head long oval, distinctly longer than wide, narrowed anteriorly, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle opening exactly behind the posterior margin of the postclypeus; eyes and ocelli absent; antennae 13—15-segmented, segment 2 about half of segment 1, segment 3 variable; labrum slightly longer than wide, the tip pointed with a transparent end, with a pair of long setae below the tip; postclypeus narrow, trapezoidal; mandibles sabre-shaped, the tips incurved; postmentum long, rod-like, widest in the anterior third; pronotum flat, narrower than the head width, anterior margin convex with a distinct blunt median notch. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.25—1.50; maximum head width 1.00—1.20; anterior head width 0.63—0.70; head height 0.65—0.75; head contraction index 0.60; head index 0.82; labrum length 0.30—0.35, width 0.25—0.28; mandible length 0.80—0.90; head—mandible index 0.63; postmentum midlength 0.85—1.00, maximum width 0.35—0.40, waist width 0.20—0.25; pronotum length 0.38—0.45, width 0.68—0.91; pronotum index 0.53; pronotum/head width index 0.58; antennae 13—15-segmented.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The type specimens are cotypes (Holmgren 1911 did not designate a holotype), deposited in Vienna, the American Museum of Natural History, the Silvestri collection, the Indian Forest Research Institute (Dehra Dun) and the Holmgren collection. Distribution: Sri Lanka and Tamil Nadu, India.
